desc:
Get ready to reach 1,500 MPH (~2414 KM/H) in the FASTEST nitro car game on Roblox!
🚗 Drive FREE supercars with INFINITE nitro!
⭐ Collect star coins and smash speed barriers to buy new cars, upgrades, and customizations!
💥 Enjoy crashing, jumping, and driving around with realistic physics and suspension! Well... realistic except for the speed, lol

⚠️ Please give us feedback through the Roblox group forums so we can improve! ⚠️

Driving tips:
- Press V (or the flip button on mobile) to not only flip your vehicle, but stabilize it if you lose control!
- Steering is sharper at lower speeds, so be careful not to spin out! Switching directions too fast is likely to destabilize the car.
